verses.text: The word of the LORD that came to Joel, the son of Pethu'el:
Hear this, you aged men,
Tell your children of it,
What the cutting locust left,
Awake, you drunkards, and weep;
For a nation has come up against my land,
It has laid waste my vines,
Lament like a virgin clothed with sackcloth
The cereal offering and the drink offering are cut off
The fields are laid waste,
Be confounded, O tillers of the soil,
The vine withers,
Put on sackcloth and lament, O priests,
Sanctify a fast,
Alas for the day!
Is not the food cut off
The seed shrivels under the clods,
How the beasts groan!
Unto you, O LORD, I cry.
Even the wild beasts cry to you
Blow the trumpet in Zion;
a day of darkness and gloom,
Fire devours before them,
Their appearance is like the appearance of horses,
As with the rumbling of chariots,
Before them peoples are in anguish,
Like warriors they charge,
They do not jostle one another,
They leap upon the city,
The earth quakes before them,
The LORD utters his voice
“Yet even now,” says the LORD,
and tear your hearts and not your garments.”
Who knows whether he will not turn and repent,
Blow the trumpet in Zion;
gather the people.
Between the vestibule and the altar
Then the LORD became jealous for his land,
The LORD answered and said to his people,
“I will remove the northerner far from you,
“Fear not, O land;
Fear not, you beasts of the field,
“Be glad, O sons of Zion,
“The threshing floors shall be full of grain,
I will restore to you the years
“You shall eat in plenty and be satisfied,
You shall know that I am in the midst of Israel,
“And it shall come to pass afterward,
Even upon the menservants and maidservants

And it shall come to pass that all who call upon the name of the LORD shall be delivered; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there shall be those who escape, as the LORD has said, and among the survivors shall be those whom the LORD calls.
“For behold, in those days and at that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,

I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the valley of Jehosh’aphat, and I will enter into judgment with them there, on account of my people and my heritage Israel, because they have scattered them among the nations, and have divided up my land,
and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a harlot, and have sold a girl for wine, and have drunk it.

“What are you to me, O Tyre and Si'don, and all the regions of Philis'tia? Are you paying me back for something? If you are paying me back, I will repay your deed upon your own head swiftly and speedily.
For you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my rich treasures into your temples.
You have sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, removing them far from their own border.
But now I will stir them up from the place to which you have sold them, and I will repay your deed upon your own head.
I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the sons of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabe'ans, to a nation far off; for the LORD has spoken.”
Proclaim this among the nations:
Beat your plowshares into swords,
Hasten and come,
Let the nations bestir themselves,
Put in the sickle,
Multitudes, multitudes,
The sun and the moon are darkened,
And the LORD roars from Zion,
“So you shall know that I am the LORD your God,
“And in that day
“Egypt shall become a desolation
But Judah shall be inhabited for ever,
I will avenge their blood, and I will not clear the guilty,
